name: MOO_OPTY_ROLLUPS
description: The MOO_OPTY_ROLLUPS table stores Rollup Metrics data.

columns.name: OPTY_ID
columns.description: An identifier for the Opportunity used as a foreign key to the MOO_OPTY table.

columns.name: NUM_OF_CALL_MADE
columns.description: Total number of interactions of type call where direction is outbound, made in context of opportunity.

columns.name: NUM_OF_EMAIL_SENT
columns.description: Total number of interactions of type email where direction is outbound, made in context of opportunity.

columns.name: LAST_CALL_MADE
columns.description: Last interaction of type call where direction is outbound, made in context of opportunity.

columns.name: LAST_EMAIL_SENT
columns.description: Last interaction of type email where direction is outbound, made in context of opportunity.

columns.name: NUM_OF_TOUCHES
columns.description: Number of interactions where direction is outbound, made in context of opportunity.

columns.name: LAST_TOUCH
columns.description: Last interaction where direction is outbound, made in context of opportunity.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_ACTY
columns.description: The total number of activities that are open for opportunity: tasks which are not yet completed/cancelled, appointments in future, call reports in future.

columns.name: LAST_COMPLETED_ACTIVITY
columns.description: The date of last completed activity for an opportunity. Activity includes task, appointment, and call report.

columns.name: TOTAL_COMPLETED_ACTIVITIES
columns.description: The total number of completed activities for an opportunity.

columns.name: NEXT_TASK_DUE
columns.description: The date when a task is due for an opportunity.

columns.name: TOTAL_QUOTES
columns.description: The total number of quotes for an opportunity.

columns.name: TOTAL_NOTES
columns.description: The total number of public notes associated with an opportunity.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for extensibility.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Corporate currency code for extensibility.

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate type for extensibility.
